reviewer: Codex light owner, actual images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: The preserved two-mast coaster arrangement, square-sail tiers and aft boom/sail remain distinct, with visible standing and running rigging.
Fine hull grain, the low working deck/cuddy, open battery and outboard rig fittings give the intact vessel a working coastal character.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: The real cargo hatch has a deep timber coaming, individually solid stair treads and handrails, with the fitted capstan and messenger rope beside the opening.
At the matched 4.5 m field, separate staggered deck boards show grain and seams; worn iron barrels, trunnions, timber carriages and tackle eyes resolve clearly.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The explicitly corrected intact camera reveals fine sole-board grain, curved ribs, bilge stringers, overhead beams and the actual mast framing; companion treads no longer fill the lens.
Planked side cargo storage with iron bands and a framed glass lantern are visible in the working hold. All actual visual meshes remain present, with natural depth toward the aft structure.
views.scope: Intact actual-GLB hold view with an explicit asset-local camera pose; the default pose was obstructed by companion treads. Frozen lens, lighting, samples, materials and geometry are retained.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The declared hull/deck cutaway exposes repeated ribs, longitudinal inner structure, the real cargo-hatch stair and fitted side storage through the working hold.
This bright wide view documents the structural arrangement; fine material detail is assessed in the intact close-ups. The delivered GLB geometry is unchanged.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The compact cuddy contains an actual bench, iron-banded planked locker and framed lantern, with fine grain on the sole and wall boards.
The real forward doorway opens directly onto companion treads; curved ribs, inner stringers and overhead timber remain in the intact view under disclosed auxiliary lighting.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway makes the bench and locker arrangement inspectable within the actual compact sole and curved frame envelope.
The modest framed stern light, curved ribs, inner stringers and sole edges show the cuddy's constrained geometry; only the listed hull/upper timbers are temporarily hidden.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

limitations: Static geometry and PBR inspection only; gameplay controllers and historical exactness are not certified.

The intact hold pose is explicitly corrected by asset-local detail-camera-overrides.json and render-detail-overrides.py because the default camera intersected companion treads. The actual model, all visual geometry, frozen renderer, lens, eye height, lighting preset and sample settings are unchanged.
Wide cutaways are labelled structural supplements; grain and fitting finish are assessed in the intact deck, corrected hold and cabin close-ups.
